catalogue_card.question: Can your UI review see the user journey?
catalogue_card.text: OpenAI Product Design Audit is a new lane for a live flow you can capture step by step. It can tie review notes to screenshots, but it cannot audit a journey you cannot run or prove full accessibility from pixels.
